content.comment_body: Hello, I'd like to change the default password ("[product_name]") used to switch the menu access level from operator to admin, but I can't find a way to do it. Any help appreciated!
Could you specify which [product_name] you are using? The access control settings vary between different [product_name] versions.

Your PC must be connected to the [product_name]. After that: Go to Tools > Transfer > Access Control. In the window, navigate to the last menu item, which covers control operation from the [product_name] TD. Allow [product_name] access, set the new password for the OnBoard User, confirm it, and press 'Apply'. [IMAGE]
Thanks! What should be done if the [product_name] is not connected? The instructions seem a bit unclear.
You don't actually need a [product_name] connected. However, [company_name] has placed the password settings in this section.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unsure about how to change the default password for switching menu access levels on [product_name] [version_no]. The provided information and user interface for password management are not clearly explained, especially relating to scenarios with or without a [product_name] device connected, which causes uncertainty about access control options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to have a simple method to change the access level password regardless of whether a [product_name] is connected, along with clear, easy-to-follow instructions.
